title: Giurgeni – Vadu Oii Bridge
scope: Complete Giurgeni – Vadu Oii crossing: five haunched main river spans on four battered cutwater piers, long graded smaller-pier approaches, full four-lane roadway, concrete verge walks, W guardrails and shared expanded-metal outer fencing, paired curved two-height streetlight arms and distinct bank abutments. The full1499.943m mapped envelope controls placement; the720m river core is not substituted for the whole crossing.
heightPolicy: Fixed3m standard terrain datum; graded road endpoints13.5m west/12.5m east and26m central crest. Monotone cubic deck profile follows the broad hump seen in ordinary pictures. Approximate exterior elevations and support stations require actual native approach, river and independent farm-track clearance checks; standard terrain is not flattened.
limitations: Ordinary-picture exterior approximation, not a surveyed engineering model. The river panorama and road photograph control the five-span haunched form, broad four-lane deck, open metal fencing and curved paired lamps. One unrelated stock picture showing a railway/truss crossing is excluded.

The retained1499.943m envelope includes approach viaducts; reported1464m length is a separate scope measure. Concealed structure, support spacing, haunch depths, profile elevations, bearings and below-ground foundations are photo/map-guided approximations. No copied mesh, private photo texture, vehicles or readable signs. Native terrain is coarse; physical-device timing remains unmeasured.
